messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up for last night's streaming degradation. I pulled a short task list; need owners + dates. Incident summary posted by sre-bot below.
sre-bot: Incident 2167889000: streaming endpoint experienced elevated partial responses and increased idle timeouts 03:14-03:43 UTC. Automated rollback executed.
devon: Thanks. I'm happy to own the reconnect/backoff changes. I'll propose a backoff range and a client opt-in flag. ETA EOD Wed.
esteban: I'll take the server-side heartbeat/keepalive tweak (session leash enforcement). Need clarity on acceptable false-positive rate. Can we target <0.5% dropped sessions after change?
maria: Yes, target <0.5% and no >5% CPU uplift on p4d. Devon, can you add an A/B rollout plan in the PR? Use canary=5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2hr observation windows.
kevin: I'll own observability: add a new metric stream.partial_chunk_rate and a histogram for client_ack_latency. Will also add alerts: burn rate + absolute threshold.
ajohnson: I'll update SDKs for graceful reconnection and to expose last_chunk_id ack. Minimal change: expose reconnectBackoffMs param. PR draft tomorrow.
devon: sample backoff I'm thinking:
```
const reconnectBackoff = (attempt) => Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, attempt), 20000);
```
Add jitter +/-20%.
maria: Good. Also need tests: unit for kv-cache reuse + integration test simulating intermittent network with 250ms jitter. esteban, pinged you for test harness infra.
esteban: I'll wire up a deterministic fault injector in the streaming test harness. ETA Fri.
maria: Owner mapping recap: reconnect/backoff: devon (EOD Wed); session leash/heartbeat: esteban (Fri); SDKs: ajohnson (Thu); metrics/alerts: kevin (Mon); rollout plan + canary gates: devon+kevin (PRs linked). I'll open a follow-up issue and link to this thread.
kevin: Adding alert thresholds proposal: partial_chunk_rate > 0.8% sustained 5m OR client_ack_latency p95 > 2s.
maria: Ownership + deadlines in thread, assigning Jira tickets now. @deploy-bot can you post the incident summary to #incidents/archives when I add links?
deploy-bot: Will post after tickets created.
ajohnson: One more ask — add a QA checklist item: "no partial responses observed in 500 synthetic sessions" before full rollout.
maria: Agreed. Acceptance criteria: 1) partial_chunk_rate drop >=80% in canary traffic; 2) no regression in latency by >10%; 3) SDKs backward compatible.
devon: I'll also add a regression test for chunk watermarking to catch duplicate chunk emission.
esteban: Noted recurring pattern: we've seen small spikes every ~21-28 days aligned with a particular batch window. I'll add a log enrichment to trace batch window IDs to incident logs.
maria: Weekly sync for 6 weeks to watch recurrence. First check-in next Tue 11:00 PT. I'll create calendar invite.
kevin: I'll prepare dashboards and a short runbook snippet for on-call to triage partial responses quickly.
maria: Thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll mark this thread as the single source for postmortem action items and link to the PM doc.
ajohnson: no objections :thumbsup:
devon: ack :+1:
sre-bot: Follow-up checklist created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2167890123/followup
maria: Closing comments — keep updates in this thread only so we preserve owner history.
